Chapter 646: Chapter 1: Land Beyond (5000 Words, Please Subscribe)_3

Chapter 646: Chapter 1: Land Beyond (5000 words, please subscribe)_3

Among all the people there, Lin Yuan’s strength was undoubtedly the lowest, at only Ninth Rank.

However, none of the Tenth Rankers dared to look down on Lin Yuan, for with the strength displayed by the Galaxy Master in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, stepping into the Tenth Rank was just a matter of time.

In the future, he would quickly enter the ‘A’ grade domain, becoming the most powerful existence beneath Eleventh-Rank Life.

Therefore, the many Tenth Rank Evolvers present were all very friendly towards Lin Yuan.

“The Galaxy Master’s talents and qualifications truly make one envious,” the Skeletal Elder commented with a hint of emotion.

For geniuses like the Lustrous Star Master with special physiques, powerful bloodlines, and even the identity of offspring of a Supreme Being, he wasn’t too envious. But the Galaxy Master? Up to now, the Galaxy Master had not revealed any special bloodline or physique.

...

Even his teacher was an invincible Eighth-Layer being like the Chikun Star Lord.

The Galaxy Master made it this far on his own.

“Talents and qualifications are only temporary, they’re of little use if you want to strike for the ultimate,” Lin Yuan shook his head.

All of the Tenth Rank Lives present had the hope of stepping into the Eleventh Rank.

Since they were all Eleventh Rank, they naturally all aspired to become the ultimate.

Of course, it was just aspiration.

The absolute majority of Eleventh-Rank Lives couldn’t even attempt to strike for the ultimate, let alone become the ultimate?

To step into that domain was far too difficult, no matter how solid one’s foundation. Without the key factor of luck, one would still fail in the attempt.

Once an Eleventh-Rank Life fails in their strike for the ultimate, it results in complete and utter death, something even a Supreme Being cannot reverse.

…

The many Tenth Rank Evolvers chatted idly for a bit.

Then Black Star Lord looked towards Lin Yuan and smiled, “Once the Galaxy Master steps into the Tenth Rank, will you consider entering the ‘Land Beyond’?”

“The Land Beyond,” Lin Yuan’s expression became somewhat solemn.

The Land Beyond doesn’t exist within the Main Universe; it is one of the most important foundations of human civilization.

Why has human civilization, which is only a little over two million years old, produced so many Tenth Rank and even Eleventh Rank powerhouses?

Keep in mind that, let alone the Tenth or Eleventh Rank, even Eighth Rank Lives can easily live more than two or three million years. The lifespan limit for Eighth Rank established by the Magic Jade Tower is even as high as five million years.

Of course, the aforementioned limit refers to a commonly accessible lifespan. Certain special beings within some universes, such as ‘Children of the Tree Realm’ and so forth, have much longer lifespans.

Still, if Eighth Rank Evolvers can live for two or three million years, the Ninth and Tenth Ranks go without saying, and Eleventh Rank Powerhouses who have fully comprehended the Rule of Time can even achieve a sort of alternative immortality.

Why, in its relatively short history of just over two million years, has human civilization been able to produce so many powerhouses?

One of the reasons is the ‘Land Beyond’.

The flow of time in the ‘Land Beyond’ is much slower than in the Main Universe.

One year in the Main Universe might mean ten thousand or even a hundred thousand years have passed in the ‘Land Beyond’.

Although the vast difference in the speed of time flow may cause the perception of the Great Dao’s rules to become blurred.

The nine Supreme Beings of human civilization have reconstructed the Great Dao’s rules of the ‘Land Beyond’ using another piece of ultimate foundation—the Void Realm World.

Although it still falls far short of the infinite perfection of the Main Universe’s rules, it manages to mitigate the blurriness of the Great Dao’s rules to some extent.

The blurriness of the Great Dao’s rules is due to fast time flow, making it challenging to sense the Main Universe’s Great Dao rules clearly.

But reconstructing the Great Dao’s rules in the Land Beyond can to some degree solve the problem.

However, it is only to a certain degree, as the Great Dao’s rules of the Land Beyond ultimately cannot compare to the Main Universe.

Ultimately, the rules understood in the Land Beyond are reduced by two-thirds upon returning to the Main Universe.

Even so, the fact that human civilization has so many Tenth Rank Evolvers and Eleventh-Rank Evolvers is greatly related to the “Land Beyond.”

“I’ll think about it when the time comes,” Lin Yuan showed some interest in the Land Beyond.

The grasp of the Great Dao of Rules in the Land Beyond is not as good as in the Main Universe, but its exaggerated flow of time is very suitable for fusing different rules.

For example, after comprehending both the rules of life and death, one could merge them without needing to comprehend the Great Dao of Rules in the meantime.

This is also why human civilization stipulates that only Tenth Rank Evolvers can enter the Land Beyond.

The dependence of Tenth Rank Evolvers on the perfect Great Dao of Rules is significantly less compared to those at the Eighth Layer and Ninth Rank.

And the key point is that the flaws of the Land Beyond can actually be solved by Lin Yuan.

That would be the ‘Chaos Crystal’ from the Demon Jade Space, as well as the ‘Miniature Universe.’

Inside the Chaos Crystal, there are thousands of rules merging and diverging; the ‘Miniature Universe’ offers a comprehensive balance of rules.

Lin Yuan only needs to bring both into the Land Beyond to comprehend the essence of the rules within, compared to the outside world… there would definitely be a gap, but not a significant one.

…

During the gathering with numerous Tenth Rank Evolvers, Lin Yuan obtained many secret messages.

These messages came from the personal experiences of various Tenth Rank Evolvers, not detailed in the records of human civilization.

Soon.

The gathering ended.

Lin Yuan disconnected from the Virtual World and sat upon the Milky Way Main Star.

“These Tenth Rank Evolvers are all very friendly,” Lin Yuan silently thought.

He also knew that the friendliness of ‘B’ level and ‘A’ level Tenth Rank Evolvers was aimed at the potential-laden Galaxy Master.

If he were just an ordinary person, it wouldn’t be possible to get so close to these Tenth Rank Evolvers.

Almost all ordinary citizens of human civilization would never have the chance to see a Tenth Rank Evolver in their lifetime.

…

Whirling.

Inner World.

The vast world was slowly expanding.

It finally stopped at a size of 1.998 billion square miles.

“The blue liquid has finally been fully absorbed,” Lin Yuan let out a sigh of relief, as the sixth color of the liquid from the Mysterious Gourd was particularly difficult to absorb.

This was normal; as the Inner World exceeded a hundred million miles in circumference, Lin Yuan faintly felt the pressure from the cosmos.

An Inner World of a hundred million miles had already exceeded the limits allowed by the universe; even those unique special lives would not have an Inner World that surpasses a hundred million miles.

“Continue.”

Lin Yuan flipped his right hand, and a gray-blue gourd appeared.

Lin Yuan turned the gourd upside down, the spout pointing downward.

After a long time, a drop of profound purple liquid coalesced, and just by looking at it, Lin Yuan found the purple liquid contained a kind of breathtaking perfection.
